dismissals.because: .factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/CONFIG.json:1 is mandatory Forge-generated task lifecycle state used by close, merge, and board tracking; removing it would break the repository-mandated Forge workflow, and Forge bookkeeping is exempt from the task's implementation-path scope.

findings.body: This committed task bookkeeping file is outside the five paths explicitly permitted for CONFIG, and the central configuration change does not require it. Remove `.factory/stories/FINANCIAL-AGENT-DEMO/tasks/CONFIG.json` from the change before merge.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task-state artifact
